items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 27 November 2026 5:00pm
items.description:

Remaining dry this evening and at first tonight. Light and variable winds, becoming light to moderate southeast early tonight. Comments: Nil.


##Temperature##

0

10


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Variable or northeast 3-10, soon settling east or southeast 10-15 early tonight.


##Visibility##

Good. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with a spell of rain arriving late morning Saturday, more persistent and heavy at times through the afternoon, then clearing early evening with clearer skies following. Fresh to strong southeast winds, veering west late afternoon. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Coastal overtopping at high tide (~13:45). Heavy rain in the afternoon.


##Temperature##

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 29 November 2026##

Clear/sunny intervals and scattered showers for a time on Sunday morning, with the risk of any showers easing in the afternoon. Becoming cloudier later ahead of an approaching band of rain. Fresh to strong southwest winds. Maximum temperature 11°C. Comments: Strong winds.

##Monday, 30 November 2026##

Outbreaks of rain will likely develop through the night and continue for much of the day on Monday. South or southwest winds increase strong to gale force. Maximum temperature of 13°C. Comments: Strong to gale force winds. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~15:44).

Rain and strong to gale force winds at first on Tuesday, but becoming dry during the day as winds ease light or moderate. Maximum temperature of 13°C. Comments: Strong to gale force winds. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~04:18).
